name: el_nino
description: El Niño is a Layer-3 paper-trading analysis system: an autonomous trading-engine core in Python (risk-control guardrail, regime, gold confidence, and execution slices) paired with JARVIS, a read-only React + TypeScript graph-intelligence UI that projects an ontology-governed dev_graph knowledge base via a FastAPI/Neo4j backend. Note: this project has over 100 source files; consider scoping analysis to a subdirectory for faster results.
